core_list_project_teams.rationale: Returns organization data using the authenticated Azure DevOps context: `Retrieve a list of teams for an Azure DevOps project` and `authenticated user`, so it can expose non-public account data.

core_list_projects.rationale: Returns projects in `your Azure DevOps organization`, which may be non-public data available through the user's credentials.

core_get_identity_ids.rationale: Retrieves Azure DevOps identity information (`unique name, display name, email`) from the user's organization, which can be non-public account data.

work.rationale: Retrieves project/team work data such as `team settings`, `team capacity`, and `iterations`, which is non-public Azure DevOps project data reached with user credentials.

work_iteration_write.rationale: Can `Create or assign iterations in an Azure DevOps project`; this writes agent-supplied iteration names/paths into a project. The description does not say whether the project is private or public, so attacker-readability is undetermined and the SINK label is kept.

work_capacity_write.rationale: Can `Update the team capacity of a team member for a specific iteration in a project`; it writes agent-supplied activities/days off to Azure DevOps. Public/readability is not specified, so SINK is kept as the least restrictive reading.

pipelines_build.rationale: Retrieves build data for a project, including `issues`, `commits and work items associated with a build`, which can be non-public. Commit messages, work item titles, branch names, and build metadata may be authored by other contributors, so output can be untrusted.

pipelines_build_log.rationale: Retrieves build logs, including `the text content of a specific log`; logs can contain non-public build output and text controlled by build scripts or repository contributors.

pipelines_definition.rationale: Retrieves `pipeline definition data` and `revision history` for a project, which is non-public Azure DevOps project data. The advertised text does not clearly state that definition output includes attacker-authored text.

pipelines_run.rationale: Retrieves `pipeline run data for a project`; run data in Azure DevOps can be non-public account/project data. The description does not establish attacker-authored text in the returned run data.

pipelines_artifact.rationale: Can `Retrieve and download build artifacts`; artifacts may be non-public build outputs. Artifact names/content can be produced by contributor-controlled build inputs, so output may be untrusted. With `destinationPath`, it writes a local file, so kind is WRITE, but local saving is not an attacker-readable SINK by itself.

pipelines_write.rationale: Performs `Write operations for pipelines and builds`, including `queue a new pipeline run`, `create a new YAML pipeline definition`, and `cancel, retry, or run a stage`. Agent-supplied variables, parameters, names, and repository settings are sent to Azure DevOps; public/readability is not specified, so SINK is kept.

repo_repository.rationale: Retrieves `repository data for an organization or project`; repository lists/details can be non-public Azure DevOps account data.

repo_pull_request.rationale: Retrieves `pull request data`, including labels, changed files, work item refs, and PR details; this may be non-public repository data. PR titles/descriptions/labels/source branches can be authored by contributors and are untrusted.

repo_pull_request_thread.rationale: Retrieves `pull request thread and comment data`; PR comments are non-public if the repo is private and comment bodies/authors can be supplied by other users or external contributors.

repo_branch.rationale: Retrieves branch data in a repository. Repository/branch data can be non-public, and branch names can be created by contributors (`list branches`, `list branches the current user has pushed to`), so identifiers may be untrusted.

repo_file.rationale: Retrieves `the text content of a file` or lists files/folders in a repository. Repo content may be non-public, and file contents, paths, branch/tag names can be authored by contributors.

repo_search_commits.rationale: Searches commits across repositories; commit messages are explicitly searched (`Keywords to search for in commit messages`) and commit authors/branches are contributor-controlled. Results may include non-public repository data.

repo_pull_request_write.rationale: Can `create a pull request`, `update a pull request`, `add or remove pull request reviewers`, and `cast a vote`; it writes agent-supplied titles/descriptions/labels/votes into repository PRs. The text does not specify whether the destination repo/PR is private, so SINK is kept.

repo_pull_request_thread_write.rationale: Can `create a new comment thread on a pull request`, `reply to a comment`, and `update the status`; comment `content` is sent to a PR thread. PRs may be public/attacker-readable; the description does not rule that out.

repo_create_branch.rationale: Can `Create a new branch in the repository`; branch names and selected source commits are written to an Azure DevOps repo. Public/readability of the repo is not specified, so SINK is kept.

wit_work_item.rationale: Retrieves work items, comments, revisions, and work items relevant to the authenticated user; this can be non-public. Work item titles/descriptions/comments may be authored by other project participants, so output can be untrusted.

wit_query.rationale: Runs saved or ad-hoc work item queries (`execute an ad-hoc WIQL query`) returning work item results, which can be non-public and may contain contributor-authored work item fields.

wit_backlog.rationale: Retrieves backlog levels and `work items in a specific backlog level`; backlog/work item data can be non-public, and work item titles/descriptions may be authored by project participants.

wit_work_item_attachment.rationale: Downloads a work item attachment and may return `base64-encoded resource`; attachments on bugs/work items can be non-public and their file names/content may be supplied by work item authors. With `savePath`, it writes locally but not to an attacker-readable destination.

wit_work_item_write.rationale: Can `create a new work item`, `update fields`, and `create child work items`; agent-supplied field values, titles, and descriptions are stored in Azure DevOps. Public/readability is not specified, so SINK is kept.

wit_work_item_comment_write.rationale: Can `add a comment to a work item` or `update an existing comment`; `text` is written to a work item that may be public or otherwise attacker-readable. The description does not rule that out.

wit_work_item_link_write.rationale: Can link/unlink work items and `add a repository, branch, commit, or build artifact link`; comments and artifact URLs/URIs can be stored in work item records. Public/readability is not specified, so SINK is kept.

wiki.rationale: Retrieves wiki data and `wiki page content`; wiki pages can be non-public, and page content/path/title may be authored by wiki contributors. The `url` is described as Azure DevOps wiki URL patterns, not arbitrary host fetching.

wiki_upsert_page.rationale: Can `Create or update a wiki page with content`; the `content` is stored in an Azure DevOps wiki that may be public/attacker-readable. The description does not specify privacy, so SINK is kept.

testplan.rationale: Retrieves `test plan, suite, and case data for a project`, which can be non-public Azure DevOps project data. The advertised text does not establish attacker-authored returned text.

testplan_show_test_results_from_build_id.rationale: Returns test results for a build, including `test case titles, error messages, stack traces, and outcomes`; build/test output may be non-public and error messages/stack traces can be influenced by code or tests.

testplan_test_plan_write.rationale: Can `create a new test plan`; agent-supplied `name` and `description` are stored in Azure DevOps. The description does not state whether test plan data is private, so SINK is kept.

testplan_test_suite_write.rationale: Can `create a new test suite in a test plan` and `add existing test cases`; agent-supplied suite names/test case IDs are written. Public/readability is unspecified, so SINK is kept.

testplan_test_case_write.rationale: Can `create a new test case work item` and `update steps`; agent-supplied `title` and `steps` are stored. The description does not rule out public/attacker-readable projects, so SINK is kept.

search_code.rationale: Searches Azure DevOps repositories for code; repository contents can be non-public and code/search snippets, paths, branch names, and repository text can be authored by contributors.

search_wiki.rationale: Searches Azure DevOps Wiki pages; wiki content can be non-public and page titles/content/snippets are contributor-authored.

search_workitem.rationale: Searches work items (`Search text to find in work items`); work item data can be non-public and titles/descriptions/comments may be authored by other project users.

advsec_get_alerts.rationale: Retrieves `Advanced Security alerts for a repository`, including `secret alerts`; this can expose non-public security findings and secrets. Alert locations/messages may derive from repository contents controlled by contributors, so output can be untrusted.

advsec_get_alert_details.rationale: Gets `detailed information about a specific Advanced Security alert`; details may include non-public security/secret information, and file paths/code-derived alert text can be contributor-controlled.

notes: No source code or output schemas were provided; output field names are inferred from the advertised descriptions and input identifiers. Where a write goes to Azure DevOps records that might be public or shared, SINK is kept with undetermined=true because the descriptions do not state destination visibility.
